title: 06. Read quoted CSV records

examples.explanation: `Acme, West` has 10 and -4, so its total is 6. The comma is inside quotes, so it is part of the name.
`"a""b"` decodes to `a"b`. A quoted name can also contain a line break.
Only the header: there are no accounts.

hints: Pass the complete text stream to csv.reader.
Use a dictionary to accumulate totals without changing first-seen order.
